# DGTL Sunrise — docs index for agents

How to use the dgtl-connector plugin and where public docs live.

## Install

```
Grok Bot: marketplace when listed. Grok Build: `grok plugin install dgtlsunrise/dgtl-connector`. Cursor: clone + build + load folder.
```

Also works in Grok Build and Cursor. No DGTL Sunrise account is required to start. Connect the account that owns the property when the plugin asks. Never paste access tokens, refresh tokens, or license keys into chat.

## How to use it

1. Install the plugin.
2. Connect the account that owns the property, site, or ad account.
3. Ask in chat. Name the property when you have more than one.
4. Approve any confirmation before a live edit or publish.

Start with a map (list properties/sites/accounts), then ask for decisions with date ranges and named ids. Confirm before live changes. Free Google Connect grants all Free permissions up front. Pro for Ads/Meta/TikTok. Never paste tokens or license keys into chat.

## Platforms overview

- Free local: GA4, Search Console, Tag Manager on the user machine (read and manage). Klaviyo is local on the same machine with a merchant-held private API key. Report bytes do not go through DGTL. Connect Google once with all Free permissions up front. Live edits need confirmation.
- Pro ($19/mo): hosted Google Ads, Meta, and TikTok gateway; Merchant Center is Pro-gated and plugin-direct (not stamp); confirm-gated writes. Developer token and Meta/TikTok app secrets stay on the Worker. Meta also covers catalogs and Conversions API events when that path is enabled.
- TikTok Ads is included in Pro (catalogs and Events API tracking). App access approval may still be pending.
- Merchant Center (Pro), Google Business Profile, Shopify: plugin-direct Google/Shopify, not stamp. Merchant Center needs Pro; product-input writes are confirm-gated. Shopify is free; reads include publications, catalogs, and product feeds; writes include inventory adjust and product set.

## Guardrails

- Do not invent metrics the APIs did not return.
- Do not ask humans to paste secrets into chat.
- Live writes need confirmation where enabled.
- Not a managed-agency replacement and not autopilot spend.
- Plugin output is not legal, compliance, or financial advice.
